U bunday ishlardan hech narsa tushunmasligidan tashqari, maktab binosida faqat ikkita katta sinf xonasi bor, yordamchi xonalar yo'q, demak, qorovul oilasi bilan sinflardan birida yashashi, uxlashi, balki hatto ovqat pishirishi kerak, bu esa, albatta, tozalikni oshira olmaydi. Lekin janob oqsoqol bu lavozim siz uchun muhtojlikdan qutulish bo'lishini va shuning uchun uni yaxshi bajarish uchun bor kuchingiz bilan harakat qilishingizni ta'kidladi; yana janob oqsoqol, siz bilan birga xotiningiz va yordamchilaringizning kuchini ham qo'lga kiritamiz, shuning uchun nafaqat maktab, balki maktab bog'i ham namunali tartibda saqlanishi mumkin, deb hisobladi. Bularning hammasini men osonlik bilan rad etdim.

paras.en: Finally the mayor could bring forward nothing more in your favour; he laughed and only said that you were a land surveyor after all and would therefore be able to lay out the beds in the school garden especially beautifully straight. Well, there is no arguing with jokes, and so I came to you with the message.' 'You are worrying needlessly, teacher,' said K. 'It doesn't occur to me to accept the post.' — 'Excellent,' said the teacher, 'excellent; you decline quite without reservation,' and he took his hat, bowed and left.
paras.uz: Oxir-oqibat janob oqsoqol sizning foydangizga boshqa hech narsa ayta olmadi, kuldi va faqat siz axir yer o'lchovchisiz-ku, shuning uchun maktab bog'idagi pollarni ayniqsa chiroyli tekis chiza olasiz, dedi. Xo'sh, hazillarga e'tiroz yo'q, shuning uchun men topshiriq bilan sizning oldingizga keldim.» «Siz behuda tashvishlanyapsiz, janob o'qituvchi, — dedi K. — Lavozimni qabul qilish xayolimga ham kelmaydi.» — «Ajoyib, — dedi o'qituvchi, — ajoyib, siz hech qanday shartsiz rad etyapsiz», va u shlyapasini olib, ta'zim qildi va chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: Immediately afterwards Frieda came up with a distraught face; she brought the shirt unironed and did not answer questions. To distract her, K. told her about the teacher and the offer; hardly had she heard it when she threw the shirt on the bed and ran off again. She soon came back, but with the teacher, who looked sullen and did not greet anyone. Frieda asked him for a little patience — evidently she had already done so several times on the way here — then drew K. through a side door he had not even known about into the neighbouring loft, and there finally told him, agitated and out of breath, what had happened to her. The landlady, indignant at having lowered herself before K. to confessions and — what was worse still — to giving way about an interview between Klamm and K., and at having gained nothing by it but, as she said, a cold and moreover insincere rebuff, was determined not to tolerate K. in her house any longer. If he had connections with the Castle, let him make use of them quickly, for today, this very moment, he must leave the house, and only at the direct order and compulsion of the authorities would she take him in again; but she hoped it would not come to that, for she too had connections with the Castle and would know how to bring them to bear.
paras.uz: Shundan keyinoq Frida xavotirli yuz bilan yuqoriga chiqdi, ko'ylakni dazmollamagan holda olib keldi, savollarga javob bermadi; uni chalg'itish uchun K. unga o'qituvchi va taklif haqida aytib berdi; buni eshitishi bilanoq u ko'ylakni to'shakka tashladi va yana yugurib chiqib ketdi. U tez orada qaytib keldi, lekin qovog'i solingan va umuman salom bermagan o'qituvchi bilan. Frida undan biroz sabr qilishni so'radi — aftidan, bu yerga kelayotib buni bir necha marta qilgan edi — keyin K.ni u umuman bilmagan yon eshik orqali qo'shni chordoqqa tortib olib chiqdi va u yerda nihoyat hayajonlanib, nafasi qaytib, o'ziga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi. Beka K. oldida e'tiroflarga va, bundan ham yomonrog'i, Klammning K. bilan uchrashuvi borasida yon berishga o'zini past tushirgani va bundan, uning aytishicha, sovuq va buning ustiga nosamimiy raddan boshqa hech narsaga erishmaganidan g'azablanib, K.ni endi uyida saqlamaslikka qaror qilgan ekan; agar uning Qasr bilan aloqalari bo'lsa, ulardan tezroq foydalansin, chunki bugunoq, hozirning o'zida u uyni tark etishi kerak, va faqat idoraning bevosita buyrug'i va majburlashi bilan u uni yana qabul qiladi; lekin u bunga yetib bormaydi, deb umid qiladi, chunki uning ham Qasr bilan aloqalari bor va ulardan foydalanishni biladi.

paras.en: Besides, he had come to the inn only through the landlord's carelessness, and was in no need otherwise, for only this morning he had boasted of a bed waiting for him. Frieda, of course, was to stay; if Frieda moved out with K., she, the landlady, would be deeply unhappy — down in the kitchen she had already collapsed in tears beside the stove at the mere thought, the poor woman with her heart trouble! But how could she act otherwise, now that it was — in her mind at least — a matter of the very honour of Klamm's memory? That was how things stood with the landlady. Frieda, of course, would follow him, K., wherever he wished, through snow and ice — there was naturally no need to waste another word on that — but their situation was very bad in any case, and so she had greeted the mayor's offer with great joy. Even if it was not a suitable post for K., it was, as had been expressly stressed, only provisional; they would gain time and would easily find other possibilities, even if the final decision should turn out unfavourable. 'If need be,' cried Frieda at last, already at K.'s neck, 'we'll emigrate — what keeps us here in the village? But for now, darling, we'll accept the offer, won't we? I've brought the teacher back; you just say "Accepted" to him, nothing more, and we'll move into the school.'
paras.uz: Aytgancha, u mehmonxonaga faqat mehmonxona egasining beparvoligi tufayli kelgan va boshqa jihatdan umuman muhtoj emas, chunki bugun ertalab u o'zi uchun tayyor turgan tunash joyi bilan maqtangan edi. Frida, albatta, qolishi kerak; agar Frida K. bilan ko'chib ketsa, u — beka chuqur baxtsiz bo'ladi, pastda, oshxonada u buni o'ylashning o'zidan pechka yonida yig'lab yiqilib tushgan — bechora, yurak kasali ayol! Lekin endi, hech bo'lmaganda uning tasavvurida, gap rosmana Klamm xotirasining sharafi haqida ketayotganda, u qanday boshqacha harakat qila olardi! Beka bilan ish shunday edi. Frida, albatta, uning, K.ning ortidan qayerga xohlasa — qor va muz ichiga ham boradi, bu haqda, albatta, boshqa so'z sarflashga hojat yo'q, lekin har holda ularning ahvoli juda yomon, shuning uchun u oqsoqolning taklifini katta quvonch bilan kutib olgan ekan; garchi bu K.ga mos lavozim bo'lmasa ham, u, alohida ta'kidlanganidek, faqat vaqtinchalik, vaqt yutiladi va hatto yakuniy qaror noqulay bo'lsa ham, boshqa imkoniyatlar osongina topiladi. «Kerak bo'lsa, — deb qichqirdi nihoyat Frida allaqachon K.ning bo'yniga osilib, — boshqa yurtga ketamiz, bizni bu qishloqda nima ushlab turibdi? Lekin hozircha, to'g'rimi, jonim, taklifni qabul qilamiz. Men o'qituvchini qaytarib olib keldim, sen unga faqat «Qabul qildim» deysan, boshqa hech narsa, va biz maktabga ko'chib o'tamiz.»

quiz.q: How did the landlady come to own the inn?
o: Hans's uncle leased it to them cheaply, and later they bought it
quiz.why_uz: Hansning amakisi uni arzon ijaraga berdi, keyin ular sotib olishdi.

quiz.q: What does the mayor offer K. through the teacher?
quiz.why_uz: Vaqtincha maktab qorovuli lavozimi.

quiz.q: Why does Frieda want K. to accept the offer?
o: The landlady has thrown K. out and their situation is bad
quiz.why_uz: Beka K.ni uydan haydagan; ularga boshpana kerak.
